label: Direct scan or simulation
summary: Follow the input operations or visit each required position directly.

label: Hash map or set
summary: Remember values, counts, or identities for direct lookup.

label: Two pointers
summary: Move coordinated positions while preserving an ordering or partition invariant.

label: Sliding window
summary: Maintain state for a changing contiguous range.

label: Binary search
summary: Use sorted order or a monotone condition to discard part of the search range.

label: Stack
summary: Resolve the most recently opened or unfinished operation first.

label: Monotonic stack or deque
summary: Keep ordered candidates and discard those that can no longer help.

label: Queue simulation
summary: Maintain the order in which pending operations take their turns.

label: Heap / priority queue
summary: Repeatedly select an extreme item while candidates change.

label: Quickselect partitioning
summary: Partition around a pivot and continue only where the requested rank lies.

label: Prefix / suffix accumulation
summary: Reuse aggregate information from before or after each position.

label: Candidate cancellation
summary: Cancel competing occurrences while preserving possible majority candidates.

label: Value-to-index placement
summary: Move each in-range value to its designated array position.

label: Linked-list pointer updates
summary: Save and rewire node links without losing the remaining list.

label: Fast and slow pointers
summary: Move at different speeds to detect a cycle or locate a meeting point.

label: Indexed state with recency / frequency
summary: Combine key lookup with an order that implements the eviction rule.

label: Depth-first traversal
summary: Explore a branch before returning to its siblings, recursively or with a stack.

label: Breadth-first traversal
summary: Explore a graph frontier or distance layer before moving farther.

label: Binary search tree ordering
summary: Use lower/greater value bounds to select branches or validate structure.

label: Divide and conquer
summary: Split a region into smaller independent regions and combine their results.

label: Backtracking
summary: Try a choice, explore it, then undo it before trying alternatives.

label: Trie / prefix tree
summary: Share character prefixes and advance through matching branches.

label: Topological ordering
summary: Process dependency-free vertices and release their dependents.

label: Weighted path optimization
summary: Relax path costs while respecting edge costs or an edge-count budget.

label: Minimum spanning tree
summary: Choose low-cost connections that connect every vertex without cycles.

label: Dynamic programming
summary: Define reusable subproblem states and combine already solved dependencies.

label: Expand around centers
summary: Grow matching intervals from each odd and even center.

label: Greedy invariant
summary: Make a locally justified choice that preserves a globally useful invariant.

label: Ordered interval processing
summary: Process interval boundaries in order and merge, reuse, or discard overlaps.

label: Arithmetic or counting identity
summary: Use a numerical identity, digit rule, or counting bound to compute the result.

label: Bit manipulation
summary: Use bitwise identities, masks, shifts, or bit-position contributions.

label: Eulerian edge traversal
summary: Consume every edge once and assemble the route in reverse finishing order.

label: Sort candidates by priority
summary: Re-sort the available candidate pool and take its currently best item.

label: Union-find components
summary: Merge disjoint components and use representative roots to test connectivity.
